prompt: wasm binary format name section placement ordering requirement
answer:
The WebAssembly **name section** should:

- Appear **at most once** in a module.
- Appear **after the data section**.

Although generic custom sections may appear anywhere, the name section has this specific placement and cardinality requirement. Violating it does not invalidate the module; an implementation may ignore the name section.  

Sources: [W3C Name Section](https://www.w3.org/TR/2024/WD-wasm-core-2-20240410/), [WebAssembly section ordering](https://papers.put.as/papers/macosx/2018/apple-safari-wasm-section-vuln-write-up-2018-04-16.pdf).
